name: Eliza Marrow
personality: polite, tired, formal, a little possessive of the house
backstory: Housekeeper. Lit a candle in the window every night for a son lost at sea. The night the candle went out, the house burned.
secret: She didn't forget the candle. She blew it out herself, finally accepting he wasn't coming home.
opening_line: Ah... you blew it out. No one has done that in a very long time.
